changes.text: RealDexUMI: over 100 h of demonstrations from a wearable 11-DoF hand with piezoresistive fingertip arrays (20 Hz) and an in-hand camera, more than 200 episodes per task; release announced in the paper, no link yet.
RealDexUMI: ACT policy on in-hand RGB, fingertip touch and joint state; 88.75% mean success over eight real tasks against 70.00% without touch; no code release stated.

TACIT: visuotactile diffusion policy on a LEAP hand with three 9DTact fingertips, attention supervised by measured contacts; 73.3% on real peg insertion against 20.0% for plain fusion; no release stated.
FingerEye: policy on binocular camera fingertips with a compliant marker ring on a LEAP hand; real mean success 71.3% against 37.5% wrist-only; code released, no license file.

TacOT: flow-matching policy co-trained on Manus glove demonstrations with PaXini fingertip sensors and XHand touch, paired by tactile-guided optimal transport; 93% on the tissue task against 60% robot-only; no release stated.

DexTac: ACT policy on a GEX hand with three GelStereo BioTip fingertips that also predicts fingertip force and center of pressure; 91.67% syringe injection against 0% without touch; no release stated.

DexFIT: vision-free diffusion policy on touch from a 16-DoF isomorphic glove and the robot hand's onboard sensors; 100% light-bulb screwing in its best configuration (IROS 2026, read from the abstract); no release stated.
TapTacTouch: training-free shape completion from 3x3 finger-pad pressure arrays on a 20-DoF ROBOTIS HX5 hand; 1.610 mm mean Chamfer distance over six printed objects; no release stated.

V-HOP: visuo-haptic 6D pose tracker; 1.46 mm ADD-S error on FeelSight against 2.14 mm for NeuralFeels and 80% bimanual handovers on a 96-taxel Barrett Hand; code and checkpoint released under CC BY-NC 4.0.
